title: Korean-Style Yukon Gold Potato Pancakes
description: A crispy, savory side dish inspired by Korean cuisine, featuring Yukon gold potatoes and a hint of Asian flavors.
instructions: Grate the potatoes using a box grater or a food processor.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, Korean chili flakes, and a pinch of salt.
Mix well and let it sit for 5 minutes to allow the potatoes to release excess moisture.
Using your hands, squeeze as much liquid as possible from the potatoes.
Add the rice, vegetable oil, soy sauce, and green onions to the potatoes.
Mix everything together until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture onto the pan.
Press the mixture down gently with a spatula to form a pancake.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on the first side, until the edges start to curl and the bottom is golden brown.
Flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes, until the other side is also golden brown.
